Vendored from [three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) v0.160.0, MIT License.

- `three.module.min.js` — core library (ES module build)
- `OrbitControls.js` — official camera-orbit control addon (imports `from 'three'`, resolved via the import map in `index.html`)

Self-hosted here instead of loaded from a CDN so the site has no external
runtime dependency.
